question: How many distinct customers ordered a 'Gadgets' category product?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Gadgets';

question: What is the total revenue by region?
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name;

question: What is the average order quantity per region?
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, AVG(o.quantity) AS avg_qty FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name;
